name: rails-kit
description: Rails-related skills for Claude Code and Codex

plugins.name: hyperdrive
plugins.description: Set up and maintain Rails Hyperdrive in a Rails project: development-only gems, companion skills, MCP access, and safe content sync.

plugins.name: test-performance
plugins.description: Profile and speed up Rails tests with TestProf, targeted side-effect controls, lean factories, and safely shared fixtures.

plugins.name: audit-active-record-concurrency
plugins.description: Audit concurrent Active Record writes for duplicate records, lost updates, and broken database invariants.

plugins.name: audit-n-plus-one
plugins.description: Audit Rails query growth, locate N+1 queries, and verify loading or batching fixes with regression coverage.

plugins.name: audit-transactions
plugins.description: Audit Rails transaction boundaries, rollback behavior, exception handling, and external side effects.

plugins.name: audit-http-clients
plugins.description: Audit outbound Ruby HTTP clients for timeout budgets, retry safety, error handling, secret leakage, and failure isolation.

plugins.name: audit-api-contracts
plugins.description: Audit Rails API contracts against request behavior, serializers, OpenAPI schemas, and compatibility requirements.

plugins.name: write-rubocop-cops
plugins.description: Write and test custom RuboCop cops for Ruby and Rails conventions, with version-aware rules and safe autocorrection.

plugins.name: audit-jobs
plugins.description: Audit Ruby and Rails jobs for retries, duplicate effects, delivery gaps, transaction timing, concurrency, and tenant fairness.

plugins.name: upgrade-rails
plugins.description: Assess and upgrade Rails applications with version-specific findings, configuration previews, dependency checks, and verified incremental upgrades.

plugins.name: upgrade-ruby
plugins.description: Assess and upgrade Ruby versions in Bundler and Rails applications with compatibility audits, toolchain updates, and verification.
